JDN(y,m,d,h)
BEGIN
  LOCAL a;
  IF m<=2 THEN y:=y-1; m:=m+12; END;
  a:=IP(y/100);
  RETURN IP(365.25*(y+4716))+IP(30.6001*(m+1))+d+2-a+IP(a/4)-1524.5+h/24;
END;

AT2(y,x)
BEGIN
  LOCAL z;
  IF x==0 THEN RETURN IFTE(y>=0,90,270); END;
  z:=ATAN(y/x);
  IF x<0 THEN z:=z+180; END;
  RETURN z MOD 360;
END;

GAST(j,t,om)
BEGIN
  LOCAL d,g;
  d:=j-2451545;
  g:=280.46061837+360*FP(d)+0.98564736629*d+0.000387933*t^2-t^3/38710000;
  g:=g+(-17.2*SIN(om)-1.32*SIN(2*(280.4665+36000.7698*t))
       -0.23*SIN(2*(218.3165+481267.8813*t))+0.21*SIN(2*om))*0.9175/3600;
  RETURN g MOD 360;
END;

EXPORT ARIES(y,m,d,h)
BEGIN
  LOCAL j,t;
  HAngle:=1;
  j:=JDN(y,m,d,h);
  t:=(j-2451545+DT/86400)/36525;
  RETURN GAST(j,t,125.04452-1934.136261*t);
END;

VSUM(s,tau)
BEGIN
  LOCAL k,ii,m,acc,sm;
  acc:=0;
  FOR k FROM SIZE(s) DOWNTO 1 DO
    m:=s(k); sm:=0;
    FOR ii FROM 1 TO rowDim(m) DO
      sm:=sm+m(ii,1)*COS(m(ii,2)+m(ii,3)*tau);
    END;
    acc:=acc*tau+sm;
  END;
  RETURN acc;
END;

HEL(s,tau)
BEGIN
  LOCAL v;
  HAngle:=0;
  v:={VSUM(s(1),tau)*57.2957795131,VSUM(s(2),tau)*57.2957795131,VSUM(s(3),tau)};
  HAngle:=1;
  RETURN v;
END;

NUTN(t)
BEGIN
  LOCAL om,l2,p2,dp,dq;
  om:=125.04452-1934.136261*t;
  l2:=2*(280.4665+36000.7698*t);
  p2:=2*(218.3165+481267.8813*t);
  dp:=-17.2*SIN(om)-1.32*SIN(l2)-0.23*SIN(p2)+0.21*SIN(2*om);
  dq:=9.2*COS(om)+0.57*COS(l2)+0.1*COS(p2)-0.09*COS(2*om);
  RETURN {dp,dq,23.439291111-0.0130041667*t+dq/3600};
END;

GST2(j,t,dp,ep)
BEGIN
  LOCAL d;
  d:=j-2451545;
  RETURN (280.46061837+360*FP(d)+0.98564736629*d+0.000387933*t^2-t^3/38710000
          +dp*COS(ep)/3600) MOD 360;
END;

APP(lam,bet,sl,t,j)
BEGIN
  LOCAL n,lp,l2,b2,ra,dc;
  n:=NUTN(t);
  lp:=lam-1.397*t-0.00031*t^2;
  l2:=lam+(-0.09033+0.03916*(COS(lp)+SIN(lp))*TAN(bet)+n(1)
       -20.49552*COS(sl-lam)/COS(bet))/3600;
  b2:=bet+(0.03916*(COS(lp)-SIN(lp))-20.49552*SIN(sl-lam)*SIN(bet))/3600;
  ra:=AT2(SIN(l2)*COS(n(3))-TAN(b2)*SIN(n(3)),COS(l2));
  dc:=ASIN(SIN(b2)*COS(n(3))+COS(b2)*SIN(n(3))*SIN(l2));
  RETURN {(GST2(j,t,n(1),n(3))-ra) MOD 360,dc};
END;


EXPORT SUN(y,m,d,h)
BEGIN
  LOCAL j,t,ep,v;
  HAngle:=1;
  j:=JDN(y,m,d,h);
  t:=(j-2451545+DT/86400)/36525;
  ep:=HEL(VEAR,t/10);
  v:=APP(ep(1)+180,-ep(2),ep(1)+180,t,j);
  RETURN {v(1),v(2),959.63/ep(3)/60,8.794/ep(3)/60};
END;

EXPORT PLANET(n,y,m,d,h)
BEGIN
  LOCAL j,t,s,eh,ex,ey,ez,p,x,y2,z,tl,v,dst;
  HAngle:=1;
  IF TYPE(n)==2 THEN n:=POS(PNAM,n); END;
  IF n<1 OR n>4 THEN RETURN "Unknown planet"; END;
  IF n==1 THEN s:=VVEN; END;
  IF n==2 THEN s:=VMAR; END;
  IF n==3 THEN s:=VJUP; END;
  IF n==4 THEN s:=VSAT; END;
  j:=JDN(y,m,d,h);
  t:=(j-2451545+DT/86400)/36525;
  eh:=HEL(VEAR,t/10);
  ex:=eh(3)*COS(eh(2))*COS(eh(1)); ey:=eh(3)*COS(eh(2))*SIN(eh(1)); ez:=eh(3)*SIN(eh(2));
  p:=HEL(s,t/10);
  x:=p(3)*COS(p(2))*COS(p(1))-ex; y2:=p(3)*COS(p(2))*SIN(p(1))-ey; z:=p(3)*SIN(p(2))-ez;
  tl:=0.0057755183*(x^2+y2^2+z^2)^0.5/365250;
  p:=HEL(s,t/10-tl);
  x:=p(3)*COS(p(2))*COS(p(1))-ex; y2:=p(3)*COS(p(2))*SIN(p(1))-ey; z:=p(3)*SIN(p(2))-ez;
  dst:=(x^2+y2^2+z^2)^0.5;
  v:=APP(AT2(y2,x),ATAN(z/(x^2+y2^2)^0.5),eh(1)+180,t,j);
  RETURN {PNAM(n),v(1),v(2),8.794/dst/60};
END;

EXPORT STAR(n,y,m,d,h)
BEGIN
  LOCAL j,t,a0,d0,z1,z2,th,az,a,de,om,l2,p2,dp,dq,ep,l0,mm,sl,a2,d2,dd,g;
  HAngle:=1;
  IF TYPE(n)==2 THEN n:=POS(SNAM,n); END;
  IF n<1 OR n>57 THEN RETURN "Unknown star"; END;
  j:=JDN(y,m,d,h);
  t:=(j-2451545+DT/86400)/36525;
  a0:=STARS(n,1)+STARS(n,3)*100*t/3600/COS(STARS(n,2));
  d0:=STARS(n,2)+STARS(n,4)*100*t/3600;
  z1:=(2306.2181*t+0.30188*t^2+0.017998*t^3)/3600;
  z2:=(2306.2181*t+1.09468*t^2+0.018203*t^3)/3600;
  th:=(2004.3109*t-0.42665*t^2-0.041833*t^3)/3600;
  az:=a0+z1;
  a:=AT2(COS(d0)*SIN(az),COS(th)*COS(d0)*COS(az)-SIN(th)*SIN(d0))+z2;
  de:=ASIN(SIN(th)*COS(d0)*COS(az)+COS(th)*SIN(d0));
  om:=125.04452-1934.136261*t;
  l2:=2*(280.4665+36000.7698*t);
  p2:=2*(218.3165+481267.8813*t);
  dp:=-17.2*SIN(om)-1.32*SIN(l2)-0.23*SIN(p2)+0.21*SIN(2*om);
  dq:=9.2*COS(om)+0.57*COS(l2)+0.1*COS(p2)-0.09*COS(2*om);
  ep:=23.439291-0.0130042*t+dq/3600;
  l0:=280.46646+36000.76983*t;
  mm:=357.52911+35999.05029*t;
  sl:=l0+1.914602*SIN(mm)+0.019993*SIN(2*mm)+0.000289*SIN(3*mm);
  a2:=a+((COS(ep)+SIN(ep)*SIN(a)*TAN(de))*dp-COS(a)*TAN(de)*dq
      -20.49552*(COS(a)*COS(sl)*COS(ep)+SIN(a)*SIN(sl))/COS(de))/3600;
  d2:=de+(SIN(ep)*COS(a)*dp+SIN(a)*dq
      -20.49552*(COS(sl)*COS(ep)*(TAN(ep)*COS(de)-SIN(a)*SIN(de))+COS(a)*SIN(de)*SIN(sl)))/3600;
  dd:=j-2451545;
  g:=280.46061837+360*FP(dd)+0.98564736629*dd+0.000387933*t^2+dp*COS(ep)/3600;
  RETURN {SNAM(n),(g-a2) MOD 360,(360-a2) MOD 360,d2};
END;

MSUM(tb,d,m,p,f,ee,c)
BEGIN
  LOCAL ii,a,s;
  s:=0;
  FOR ii FROM 1 TO rowDim(tb) DO
    a:=tb(ii,1)*d+tb(ii,2)*m+tb(ii,3)*p+tb(ii,4)*f;
    s:=s+tb(ii,5)*IFTE(c,COS(a),SIN(a))*ee^ABS(tb(ii,2));
  END;
  RETURN s;
END;

EXPORT MOON(y,m,d,h)
BEGIN
  LOCAL j,t,lp,dd,mm,pp,ff,ee,a1,lam,bet,dst,n,l2,ra,dc;
  HAngle:=1;
  j:=JDN(y,m,d,h);
  t:=(j-2451545+DT/86400)/36525;
  lp:=218.3164477+481267.88123421*t-0.0015786*t^2;
  dd:=297.8501921+445267.1114034*t-0.0018819*t^2;
  mm:=357.5291092+35999.0502909*t-0.0001536*t^2;
  pp:=134.9633964+477198.8675055*t+0.0087414*t^2;
  ff:=93.272095+483202.0175233*t-0.0036539*t^2;
  ee:=1-0.002516*t-0.0000074*t^2;
  a1:=119.75+131.849*t;
  lam:=lp+(MSUM(MTL,dd,mm,pp,ff,ee,0)+3958*SIN(a1)+1962*SIN(lp-ff)
       +318*SIN(53.09+479264.29*t))/1000000;
  bet:=(MSUM(MTB,dd,mm,pp,ff,ee,0)-2235*SIN(lp)+382*SIN(313.45+481266.484*t)
       +175*SIN(a1-ff)+175*SIN(a1+ff)+127*SIN(lp-pp)-115*SIN(lp+pp))/1000000;
  dst:=385000.56+MSUM(MTR,dd,mm,pp,ff,ee,1)/1000;
  n:=NUTN(t);
  l2:=lam+n(1)/3600;
  ra:=AT2(SIN(l2)*COS(n(3))-TAN(bet)*SIN(n(3)),COS(l2));
  dc:=ASIN(SIN(bet)*COS(n(3))+COS(bet)*SIN(n(3))*SIN(l2));
  RETURN {(GST2(j,t,n(1),n(3))-ra) MOD 360,dc,358473400/dst/60,ASIN(6378.14/dst)*60};
END;

EXPORT LHA(gha,lon)
BEGIN
  RETURN (gha+lon) MOD 360;
END;

EXPORT SRED(lat,dec,lha)
BEGIN
  LOCAL hc,zn;
  HAngle:=1;
  hc:=ASIN(SIN(lat)*SIN(dec)+COS(lat)*COS(dec)*COS(lha));
  zn:=AT2(-COS(dec)*SIN(lha),COS(lat)*SIN(dec)-SIN(lat)*COS(dec)*COS(lha));
  RETURN {hc,zn};
END;

EXPORT CORR(hs,lb,sd,hp)
BEGIN
  LOCAL ha,rf,h2;
  HAngle:=1;
  ha:=hs+IC/60-1.76*HE^0.5/60;
  rf:=0.0167/TAN(ha+7.32/(ha+4.32))*0.28*PRES/(TEMP+273);
  h2:=ha-rf;
  RETURN h2+lb*sd*(1+SIN(hp/60)*SIN(h2))/60+ASIN(SIN(hp/60)*COS(h2));
END;

EXPORT INT(ho,hc)
BEGIN
  RETURN (ho-hc)*60;
END;

EXPORT FIX(la,lo,s)
BEGIN
  LOCAL a,b,c,d,f,g,ii,z,p;
  HAngle:=1;
  a:=0; b:=0; c:=0; d:=0; f:=0;
  FOR ii FROM 1 TO SIZE(s) STEP 2 DO
    z:=s(ii); p:=s(ii+1);
    a:=a+COS(z)^2; b:=b+SIN(z)*COS(z); c:=c+SIN(z)^2;
    d:=d+p*COS(z); f:=f+p*SIN(z);
  END;
  g:=a*c-b^2;
  RETURN {la+(c*d-b*f)/g/60,lo+(a*f-b*d)/g/60/COS(la)};
END;

EXPORT DR(la,lo,c,v,h)
BEGIN
  LOCAL dd,dl,l2,dq,q;
  HAngle:=1;
  dd:=v*h/60;
  dl:=dd*COS(c);
  l2:=la+dl;
  dq:=LN(TAN(45+l2/2)/TAN(45+la/2));
  IF ABS(dq)>0.000000000001 THEN q:=dl*0.0174532925199/dq; ELSE q:=COS(la); END;
  RETURN {l2,((lo+dd*SIN(c)/q+180) MOD 360)-180};
END;

EXPORT RL(a,b,c,d)
BEGIN
  LOCAL dl,dp,dq,q;
  HAngle:=1;
  dl:=((d-b+180) MOD 360)-180;
  dp:=c-a;
  dq:=LN(TAN(45+c/2)/TAN(45+a/2));
  IF ABS(dq)>0.000000000001 THEN q:=dp*0.0174532925199/dq; ELSE q:=COS(a); END;
  RETURN {((dp*0.0174532925199)^2+(q*dl*0.0174532925199)^2)^0.5*3437.74677078,
          AT2(dl*0.0174532925199,dq)};
END;

EXPORT OBLQ(ho,la,z,hp)
BEGIN
  HAngle:=1;
  RETURN ho+hp/60/298.26*(-SIN(la)^2*COS(ho)+SIN(2*la)*COS(z)*SIN(ho));
END;

RV(la,lo)
BEGIN
  RETURN {COS(la)*COS(lo),COS(la)*SIN(lo),SIN(la)};
END;

XPR(u,v)
BEGIN
  RETURN {u(2)*v(3)-u(3)*v(2),u(3)*v(1)-u(1)*v(3),u(1)*v(2)-u(2)*v(1)};
END;

NRM(u)
BEGIN
  LOCAL n;
  n:=(u(1)^2+u(2)^2+u(3)^2)^0.5;
  RETURN {u(1)/n,u(2)/n,u(3)/n};
END;

VLL(u)
BEGIN
  u:=NRM(u);
  RETURN {ASIN(u(3)),((AT2(u(2),u(1))+180) MOD 360)-180};
END;

EXPORT GC(a,b,c,d)
BEGIN
  LOCAL dl,dist,c1,c2;
  HAngle:=1;
  dl:=d-b;
  dist:=ACOS(MAX(-1,MIN(1,SIN(a)*SIN(c)+COS(a)*COS(c)*COS(dl))))*60;
  c1:=AT2(SIN(dl)*COS(c),COS(a)*SIN(c)-SIN(a)*COS(c)*COS(dl));
  c2:=(AT2(-SIN(dl)*COS(a),COS(c)*SIN(a)-SIN(c)*COS(a)*COS(dl))+180) MOD 360;
  RETURN {dist,c1,c2};
END;

EXPORT GCVX(a,b,c,d)
BEGIN
  LOCAL n,v;
  HAngle:=1;
  n:=NRM(XPR(RV(a,b),RV(c,d)));
  v:={-n(3)*n(1),-n(3)*n(2),1-n(3)*n(3)};
  IF a+c<0 THEN v:={-v(1),-v(2),-v(3)}; END;
  RETURN VLL(v);
END;

EXPORT GCPT(a,b,c,d,s)
BEGIN
  LOCAL p,n,t,k;
  HAngle:=1;
  p:=RV(a,b);
  n:=NRM(XPR(p,RV(c,d)));
  t:=XPR(n,p);
  k:=s/60;
  RETURN VLL({p(1)*COS(k)+t(1)*SIN(k),p(2)*COS(k)+t(2)*SIN(k),p(3)*COS(k)+t(3)*SIN(k)});
END;

EXPORT PLOT(la,lo,s)
BEGIN
  LOCAL f,fn,fe,r,sc,cx,cy,ii,z,p,fx,fy,k,red,blu,gry;
  HAngle:=1;
  f:=FIX(la,lo,s);
  fn:=(f(1)-la)*60; fe:=(f(2)-lo)*60*COS(la);
  r:=MAX(ABS(fn),ABS(fe))+2;
  FOR ii FROM 2 TO SIZE(s) STEP 2 DO r:=MAX(r,ABS(s(ii))+2); END;
  r:=r*1.4; sc:=110/r; cx:=160; cy:=120;
  red:=RGB(200,0,0); blu:=RGB(0,0,220); gry:=RGB(170,170,170);
  RECT_P();
  LINE_P(0,cy,319,cy,gry); LINE_P(cx,0,cx,239,gry);
  FOR ii FROM 1 TO SIZE(s) STEP 2 DO
    z:=s(ii); p:=s(ii+1); fx:=p*SIN(z); fy:=p*COS(z);
    LINE_P(cx,cy,cx+fx*sc,cy-fy*sc,blu);
    LINE_P(cx+(fx+COS(z)*3*r)*sc,cy-(fy-SIN(z)*3*r)*sc,cx+(fx-COS(z)*3*r)*sc,cy-(fy+SIN(z)*3*r)*sc,red);
    TEXTOUT_P(STRING(IP(ii/2)+1),cx+fx*sc+4,cy-fy*sc+2,1,red);
  END;
  FOR k FROM 0 TO 23 DO
    LINE_P(cx+fe*sc+6*COS(15*k),cy-fn*sc-6*SIN(15*k),cx+fe*sc+6*COS(15*k+15),cy-fn*sc-6*SIN(15*k+15),0);
  END;
  TEXTOUT_P("DR at centre. Half-height "+STRING(ROUND(r,1))+" nm. Any key to exit.",4,4,1,0);
  WAIT(-1);
  RETURN f;
END;
